request: Pull LAPD crime incidents from City of Los Angeles Open Data (data.lacity.org resource 2nrs-mtv8). Filter to 2024-onward for a manageable ~200k-row slice. One row per reported crime. Enrich with victim_age_band (numeric_bin on vict_age: unknown <1 / child <18 / young_adult <30 / adult <50 / senior >=50) and crime_class (map_values on part_1_2: 1=part_1_violent_property, 2=part_2_other). Publish to 'Prep Agent / 28 - LA Crime Incidents' on Tableau Server for LAPD public-safety analytics teams, city-council policy staff, and academic criminologists. data.lacity.org is Socrata-hosted, reliable.

sources.name: LA Crime Incidents (2024+)
sources.description: LAPD-reported crime incidents from data.lacity.org Socrata resource 2nrs-mtv8, filtered to date_occ >= 2024-01-01. Fields: dr_no (unique record #), date_rptd, date_occ, time_occ (military time HHMM), area (LAPD area code 1-21), area_name, rpt_dist_no, part_1_2 (1=Part I violent/property crimes, 2=Part II other), crm_cd, crm_cd_desc, mocodes (comma-sep modus operandi), vict_age, victim_age_band (child <18 / young_adult <30 / adult <50 / senior >=50), vict_sex (M/F/X), vict_descent (LAPD race/ethnicity single-char code), premis_cd, premis_desc, status (crime status code), status_desc, crm_cd_1, location (street address), lat, lon. Pulled via SoQL offset pagination (5000 per page).

args.name: LA Crime Trend
args.features_description: Row-level LAPD crime incidents (2024-onward, ~200k rows). Fields: dr_no, date_rptd, date_occ, time_occ, area, area_name, rpt_dist_no, part_1_2, crime_class, crm_cd, crm_cd_desc, mocodes, vict_age, victim_age_band, vict_sex, vict_descent, premis_cd, premis_desc, status, status_desc, crm_cd_1, location, lat, lon.
args.stats_description: Long-form LA crime statistics (one row per dimension x value over area_name, crime_class, victim_age_band, vict_sex). Includes 90-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify LAPD-area spikes in specific crime classes.

outputs.name: LA Crime Incidents
outputs.description: Row-level LAPD crime incidents from 2024 onward (~200k rows). Fields: dr_no, date_rptd, date_occ, time_occ, area, area_name (Central/Rampart/Southwest/etc, 21 LAPD areas), rpt_dist_no, part_1_2, crime_class (part_1_violent_property/part_2_other), crm_cd, crm_cd_desc, mocodes (LAPD modus-operandi codes), vict_age, victim_age_band (child <18 / young_adult <30 / adult <50 / senior >=50), vict_sex (M/F/X/H), vict_descent (single-char race code), premis_cd, premis_desc, status, status_desc, crm_cd_1, location, lat, lon. Source: data.lacity.org resource 2nrs-mtv8. Refresh: daily.

outputs.name: LA Crime Stats
outputs.description: Long-form LA crime statistics (one row per dimension x value over area_name, crime_class, victim_age_band, vict_sex). Includes 90-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value). Use to identify LAPD-area spikes in specific crime classes.
